title: microsorum phyllomanes
intro: Microsorum phyllomanes, commonly known as Java fern, is a species of plant in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is known for its health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce blood pressure, and possess anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Microsorum phyllomanes include its use as a diuretic, anti-diabetic, and antioxidant agent, which can help to protect against cell damage and promote overall health. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
